tasks.title: Stop /services/web-design competing with /eugene-web-design for Eugene keywords
tasks.description: Google splits Eugene web design queries between two pages. /services/web-design gets its title from app/services/[slug]/layout.js as 'Web Design Services | Eugene, OR', so it competes with /eugene-web-design ('Eugene Web Design & Web Designer | Lane County, Oregon'). Google mostly shows the weaker generic page: 'eugene web design' 53 impr at pos 35 vs 2 impr at pos 21 on the Eugene page; 'eugene website designer' 36 impr at pos 38; 'eugene oregon web design' 36 impr at pos 55 vs pos 11 on the Eugene page; 'eugene website design' 23 impr at pos 48 vs pos 12. /services/web-design went from 136 to 746 impressions this period at an average position of 42. Making the services page location-neutral and linking it to the Eugene page should push that signal to /eugene-web-design. Score: impact 5 × ease 4 = 20.
acceptance_criteria: /services/web-design <title> and meta description no longer mention Eugene; other /services/* pages keep their current titles unless deliberately changed
/services/web-design has a visible, crawlable link to /eugene-web-design with descriptive anchor text (e.g. 'Eugene web design')
/eugene-web-design title, canonical and content are unchanged
Next monthly run: Eugene web design queries going to /services/web-design drop below 30 impressions, and /eugene-web-design is the top page for them

tasks.title: Fix GA4 tracking so visits and leads can be tied to pages
tasks.description: 77 of ~100 sessions (Oct 10 – Nov 6) have landing page '(not set)', and Direct is 62 of them. Components/Analytics.jsx pushes the first page_view from a useEffect, but gtag('js') and gtag('config', GA_ID) only run later from a <Script strategy='lazyOnload'>. The first page_view usually reaches dataLayer before GA4 is configured, and visitors who leave before lazyOnload fires are never tracked. page_location is also built from origin + pathname, which drops the query string, so utm_* and gclid are lost (likely inflating 'Direct'). Separately, lead_form_submit, book_call_submit and click_phone fire but aren't marked as Key Events, so GA4 reports 0 conversions. Score: impact 4 × ease 4 = 16.
acceptance_criteria: gtag('js') and gtag('config', GA_ID, { send_page_view: false }) run before the first manual page_view (e.g. the init script uses strategy 'afterInteractive', or the effect configures before sending)
page_location includes window.location.search; page_path stays normalized (proposal tokens still stripped)
A fresh visit to /?utm_source=test&utm_medium=test shows in GA4 Realtime/DebugView with the correct landing page and source/medium
Brandon marks lead_form_submit, book_call_submit and click_phone as Key Events in GA4 Admin → Events
After 7 days, '(not set)' landing pages are under 10% of sessions
tasks.claude_code_prompt:
In C:/Users/brand/websites/visionary-advance, on a new branch 'fix/ga4-landing-page-not-set', fix GA4 attribution in Components/Analytics.jsx.
Problem: the first page_view is pushed from a useEffect before the lazyOnload init <Script> runs gtag('js')/gtag('config'), so GA4 records sessions with landing page '(not set)', and page_location drops the query string (losing utm_* and gclid).
1. Make sure gtag('js', new Date()) and both config calls (ADS_ID and GA_ID, send_page_view: false) run before any page_view: move the init to strategy='afterInteractive', or do the js/config calls once inside the effect (guarded by a window flag) before sending the event. Keep the gtag.js library script loading as now unless measurements show it's needed earlier.
2. Set page_location to window.location.origin + page_path + window.location.search, but keep normalizePath for /proposals tokens (don't include the search string on those).
3. Keep the excluded-path logic unchanged.
4. Run npm run build and `graphify update .`.
Open a PR into main explaining the '(not set)' evidence (77/~100 sessions) and how to verify in GA4 Realtime with ?utm_source=test. Remind Brandon in the PR to mark lead_form_submit, book_call_submit and click_phone as Key Events in GA4 Admin.
